result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I did not add a test for your Anna/Bob example. The existing tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` pass.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6514), I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. This is the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses. I also updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

I didn't touch the ordering or the zero-count rows, so reps without purchase orders still appear with 0, highest count first.
